lines.zh: 小爪踩过干草，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Tiny paws rustle over the dry hay.

lines.zh: 沿着墙根，我一路小跑。
lines.en: I trot along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我拐进篱笆缝。
lines.en: A flick of my tail, and I slip through the fence.

lines.zh: 麦香在前，我的胡须在抖。
lines.en: Wheat scent ahead; my whiskers are trembling.

lines.zh: 我踩着主人的靴印回家。
lines.en: I follow my owner's boot prints home.

lines.zh: 背上驮着一穗偷来的麦。
lines.en: I carry a stolen wheat ear on my back.

lines.zh: 黑毛沾了泥，我照样快。
lines.en: My black fur is muddy, but I am still quick.

lines.zh: 顺着一根藤，我爬上木箱。
lines.en: Up a vine and onto the wooden crate.

lines.zh: 白毛在月光下像一小团雪。
lines.en: My white fur looks like a scrap of snow.

lines.zh: 水沟里我划着四条短腿。
lines.en: In the ditch I paddle with four short legs.

lines.zh: 我抄近路，从地板下钻过。
lines.en: I take a shortcut underneath the floorboards.

lines.zh: 谷仓门缝，刚好够我侧身。
lines.en: The barn gap is just wide enough to squeeze through.

lines.zh: 听见猫叫，我立刻换了方向。
lines.en: A cat meows; I change direction at once.

lines.zh: 尘土地面留下一串小脚印。
lines.en: A string of tiny prints trails across the dust.

lines.zh: 我在桶沿上走了三步，没掉。
lines.en: I took three steps along the barrel rim without falling.

lines.zh: 穿过马车底，我抖了抖耳朵。
lines.en: Under the cart I go, shaking my ears as I pass.

lines.zh: 我坐着理胡须，一根一根。
lines.en: I sit and comb my whiskers, one by one.

lines.zh: 鼻子抽动，空气里有面包。
lines.en: My nose twitches; there is bread in the air.

lines.zh: 我把身体蜷成一团，睡了。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and fall asleep.

lines.zh: 粮袋满了，我数了三遍。
lines.en: The grain sack is full; I counted it three times.

lines.zh: 耳朵转向每一声细响。
lines.en: My ears turn toward every tiny sound.

lines.zh: 我啃着一块硬面包边。
lines.en: I gnaw on a hard crust of bread.

lines.zh: 洞口探出半个脑袋，够了。
lines.en: Half a head pokes from the hole; enough.

lines.zh: 我在等仓库的主人离开。
lines.en: I wait for the warehouse keeper to leave.

lines.zh: 舌头舔过前爪，再洗脸。
lines.en: My tongue sweeps my paws, then my face.

lines.zh: 这堆干草正合我意。
lines.en: This pile of hay suits me perfectly.

lines.zh: 我磨牙，木梁替我挨着。
lines.en: I grind my teeth; the beam takes the wear.

lines.zh: 屋外下雨，我留在梁上。
lines.en: It rains outside; I stay on the beam.

lines.zh: 醒来先确认粮还在。
lines.en: I wake and check my grain is still there.

lines.zh: 阳光晒暖了背，我不想动。
lines.en: Sun warms my back; I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 我把偷来的线团塞进墙洞。
lines.en: I stuff the stolen yarn ball into the wall hole.

lines.zh: 我听屋檐上的雨，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I listen to rain on the eaves and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the bread in your hand.

lines.zh: 抬头看你，眼睛亮得发贼。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes bright and thievish.

lines.zh: 是主人吗？我闻闻鞋尖。
lines.en: Is it my owner? I sniff your boot tip.

lines.zh: 你站这么近，是想喂我吗？
lines.en: Standing this close, are you here to feed me?

lines.zh: 我把头歪向左边，再歪右边。
lines.en: I tilt my head left, then right.

lines.zh: 陌生人，我先退半步。
lines.en: A stranger; I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你口袋鼓鼓，像装了麦粒。
lines.en: Your pocket bulges like it holds grain.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不眨。
lines.en: I stare at your hands without blinking.

lines.zh: 你膝盖一弯，我就凑过去。
lines.en: Your knee bends, and I shuffle over.

lines.zh: 我的胡子碰到你的指节。
lines.en: My whiskers brush against your knuckles.

lines.zh: 你要带我去收庄稼吗？
lines.en: Are you taking me to harvest the crops?

lines.zh: 这双眼睛，能看穿面包袋。
lines.en: These eyes can see through a bread sack.

lines.zh: 吱！我的胡须被压弯了。
lines.en: Squeak! My whiskers got bent.

lines.zh: 这一下，我整只鼠都僵了。
lines.en: That hit froze my whole little body.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要找面包。
lines.en: Not the head; I still need to find bread.

lines.zh: 毛被扯掉一撮，皮都露了。
lines.en: A tuft of fur is gone; bare skin shows.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，先护住肚子。
lines.en: I curl up and guard my belly first.

lines.zh: 腿有点软，但我还能跑。
lines.en: My legs feel weak, but I can still run.

lines.zh: 这点伤，回窝舔舔就好。
lines.en: A scratch like this; I will lick it in my nest.

lines.zh: 血珠沾在毛上，不显眼。
lines.en: A bead of blood hides in my fur.

lines.zh: 我发出很短的尖叫。
lines.en: I let out one very short squeak.

lines.zh: 谁打我？我记住你的鞋了。
lines.en: Who hit me? I remember your shoes.

lines.zh: 面包！我的爪子已经在刨地。
lines.en: Bread! My paws are already scraping the dirt.

lines.zh: 掰一小块，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Tear off a small piece and I will follow.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我站起来了。
lines.en: You lift the bread; I stand on my hind legs.

lines.zh: 麦粒的味道，比什么都要紧。
lines.en: The smell of grain matters more than anything.

lines.zh: 我先闻三下，再决定信你。
lines.en: Three sniffs first, then I decide to trust you.

lines.zh: 别抖手，碎屑会掉地上。
lines.en: Do not shake your hand; the crumbs will fall.

lines.zh: 这块面包够我存两天。
lines.en: This piece of bread will last me two days.

lines.zh: 我咬住边角，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite the edge and drag it backward.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我跟三步。
lines.en: You take one step; I take three.

lines.zh: 面包香盖过了猫的气味。
lines.en: Bread smell drowns out the scent of cats.

lines.zh: 我先藏起来，再慢慢吃。
lines.en: I will hide it first, then eat slowly.

lines.zh: 碎屑粘在胡须上，归我了。
lines.en: The crumbs on my whiskers are mine.

lines.zh: 为了面包，我可以暂时听话。
lines.en: For bread, I can behave for a while.

lines.zh: 你把袋子松开，我就不客气。
lines.en: Loosen the sack and I will help myself.

lines.zh: 瓜子壳裂开的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: The crack of a seed shell is my favorite sound.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才敢再靠近一寸。
lines.en: Only when you crouch do I dare come an inch closer.

lines.zh: 撞上你的靴子，我弹开了。
lines.en: I bump your boot and bounce away.

lines.zh: 小身板撞得不重，别怪我。
lines.en: My small body does not hit hard; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 哎，谁把腿放在路中间？
lines.en: Hey, who left a leg in the middle of the path?

lines.zh: 我翻身爬起，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: I roll upright and shake out my fur.

lines.zh: 被挤到一边，我照样往前钻。
lines.en: Pushed aside, I still squeeze forward.

lines.zh: 这一下把我嘴里的麦穗撞掉了。
lines.en: That knock made me drop my wheat ear.

lines.zh: 我踩了你的脚背，抱歉。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot; sorry.

lines.zh: 两只老鼠在门口撞成一团。
lines.en: Two rats collide in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我贴地一滚，从你脚边溜过。
lines.en: I roll low and slip past your feet.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我自己会走。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your foot; I will move.

lines.zh: 我把最软的一撮干草给她。
lines.en: I offer her the softest tuft of hay.

lines.zh: 两只尾巴缠在一起，算说定了。
lines.en: Two tails intertwine; that settles it.

lines.zh: 面包我分你一半，绝不再要。
lines.en: I split the bread with you, and ask no more.

lines.zh: 我们一起把窝垫厚一点。
lines.en: Together we line the nest a little thicker.

lines.zh: 她理我的耳朵，我闭眼。
lines.en: She grooms my ear; I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 夜里两只老鼠挤着取暖。
lines.en: At night two rats huddle for warmth.

lines.zh: 我守在洞口，让她先睡。
lines.en: I guard the burrow and let her sleep first.

lines.zh: 同一块面包，我们各咬一口。
lines.en: One piece of bread, a bite each.

lines.zh: 小崽子会在干草里打滚。
lines.en: Our pups will tumble in the hay.

lines.zh: 她的白毛蹭乱了我的黑毛。
lines.en: Her white fur ruffles my black coat.

lines.zh: 我叼起麦穗，转身就跑。
lines.en: I snatch the wheat ear and run.

lines.zh: 这块碎肉，正好塞牙缝。
lines.en: This scrap of meat fits between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把面包藏进墙缝。
lines.en: I stash the bread in a wall crack.

lines.zh: 腮帮子塞满，我还能再拿。
lines.en: Cheeks full, I can still carry more.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都算无主的。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the ground is unowned.

lines.zh: 我拖着胡萝卜，比我还长。
lines.en: I drag a carrot longer than I am.

lines.zh: 先咬一口，再决定搬不搬。
lines.en: One bite first, then I decide to move it.

lines.zh: 这粒种子归我的仓库了。
lines.en: This seed belongs to my storehouse now.

lines.zh: 我抱起蛋壳，轻得很。
lines.en: I pick up the eggshell; it is very light.

lines.zh: 两只爪子不够，我用嘴帮忙。
lines.en: Two paws are not enough; my mouth helps.

lines.zh: 猫的尾巴一晃，我锁定了出口。
lines.en: The cat's tail flicks; I fix on the exit.

lines.zh: 有人动我的粮袋，我盯上了。
lines.en: Someone touched my grain sack; I am watching.

lines.zh: 那块面包落地，就是我的目标。
lines.en: That bread hits the ground; it is mine to take.

lines.zh: 我认准那道缝，直冲过去。
lines.en: I pick my gap and dash straight for it.

lines.zh: 老鼠夹的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the smell of that trap.

lines.zh: 那只猫太近，我得先动。
lines.en: That cat is too close; I must move first.

lines.zh: 我看到谷仓门开了条缝。
lines.en: I see the barn door has opened a crack.

lines.zh: 目标不大：一块掉下的饼。
lines.en: My target is small: one dropped piece of bread.

lines.zh: 盯住那只手，它拿着面包。
lines.en: I fix on that hand; it holds bread.

lines.zh: 谁追我，我就往柴堆里钻。
lines.en: Whoever chases me, I dive into the woodpile.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴绷直。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail pulled straight.

lines.zh: 就等你手松一点。
lines.en: I just wait for your grip to loosen.

lines.zh: 眼睛不眨，爪尖抠着土。
lines.en: Eyes unblinking, claws dug into the dirt.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的爪子就离地。
lines.en: It moves; my paws leave the ground.

lines.zh: 这距离，三步都用不上。
lines.en: At this distance, I need less than three steps.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，避开正面。
lines.en: I circle to the side, away from the front.

lines.zh: 面包在手，你最好别晃。
lines.en: Bread in hand; better not wave it around.

lines.zh: 胡须量着风，也量着距离。
lines.en: My whiskers measure the wind and the distance.

lines.zh: 我假装走开，其实在等。
lines.en: I pretend to leave, but I am waiting.

lines.zh: 再近半格，我就扑上去。
lines.en: Half a block closer, and I pounce.

lines.zh: 我咬住脚踝，马上松口。
lines.en: I nip the ankle and let go at once.

lines.zh: 牙齿很小，疼一下还是够的。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they still sting.

lines.zh: 护食的时候，我不退。
lines.en: When guarding food, I do not back off.

lines.zh: 我从背后偷袭，一口就溜。
lines.en: I strike from behind, bite, and flee.

lines.zh: 爪子刨你鞋面，只是警告。
lines.en: My claws rake your shoe as a warning.

lines.zh: 别抢我的面包，这是我藏的。
lines.en: Do not take my bread; I hid it here.

lines.zh: 我跳起来咬住袖口。
lines.en: I leap and clamp onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 小东西急了，也会咬人。
lines.en: Even a small creature bites when cornered.

lines.zh: 一口没中，我绕第二圈。
lines.en: I miss the first bite and circle again.

lines.zh: 打完就钻洞，绝不恋战。
lines.en: Once I bite, I dive into my hole.

lines.zh: 我出生在谷仓的干草堆里。
lines.en: I was born in the barn's hay pile.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是面包屑。
lines.en: My first meal was a bread crumb.

lines.zh: 睁眼时，头顶全是麦袋。
lines.en: I opened my eyes under stacked grain sacks.

lines.zh: 这户人家的粮仓归我们了。
lines.en: This family's granary now belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我从墙缝里掉出来，摔醒了。
lines.en: I tumbled from a wall crack and woke up.

lines.zh: 母鼠把我叼到地窖角落。
lines.en: My mother carried me to a cellar corner.

lines.zh: 外面全是草味和泥土味。
lines.en: Outside smelled of grass and wet soil.

lines.zh: 我生来就会顺着绳子爬。
lines.en: I could climb a rope from birth.

lines.zh: 窝很窄，挤着三个兄弟姐妹。
lines.en: The nest is narrow, shared with three siblings.

lines.zh: 刚学会跑，就开始偷粮。
lines.en: I learned to run, then started stealing grain.

lines.zh: 皮毛焦了，面包也保不住。
lines.en: My fur singed; the bread is lost too.

lines.zh: 从梁上摔下，腿麻了。
lines.en: I fell from the beam; my legs are numb.

lines.zh: 爪子在水里乱划，快够到岸了。
lines.en: My paws flail; the bank is almost there.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡响，满嘴是灰。
lines.en: My ears ring, and my mouth is full of dust.

lines.zh: 箭扎进草堆，擦掉我一撮毛。
lines.en: The arrow strikes the hay, shaving my fur.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，像被无形的手捏住。
lines.en: I tingle, as if unseen fingers squeeze me.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连麦壳都啃。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I gnaw even husks.

lines.zh: 雷光过后，我毛都立着。
lines.en: After the lightning, my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is no bottom; I cannot grab anything.
